classification.analysis: second-brain-template is the public, fictional-data version of the owner's AI-operated Obsidian vault: a folder skeleton, slash-command engine (ported to both Claude Code skills and Gemini CLI commands), and written operating rules (self-contained notes, mandatory frontmatter, cross-links, confidence levels, a Debrief Protocol requiring file:line citations) so an AI agent can read and write the vault reliably across sessions. It syncs one-way from a companion Memory Bridge MCP server for atomic facts, ships a retrieval-eval harness measuring recall@10/MRR against a frozen case set, and enforces staged-then-triaged memory formation via Claude Code hooks (PostCompact capture, Stop-hook blocking) rather than a single unchecked save action. Aimed at builders who want an agent-agnostic, measurably reliable personal knowledge base rather than a note app built for human browsing.

use_cases.title: Bootstrap an AI-operated Obsidian vault with agent-agnostic slash commands and note rules
Measure and improve note retrieval quality with a recall@k / MRR eval harness
Enforce staged, triaged memory formation instead of unchecked auto-save via session hooks
Give both Claude Code and Gemini CLI the same vault commands and operating rules
